decisive_items: Classic-appearing hyperkeratotic lesion with many pseudohorn cysts
Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells originated from one lateral end, pushing down into the dermis and involving many hairs
Malignant squamous cells contained eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli; mitotic figures were present
response.rationale: R2 is directly supported by squamous proliferation, hyperkeratosis, pseudohorn cysts, and malignant squamous cytology. R1's PAS-positive clear cell change is contradicted by negative adipophilin and androgen receptor, which are expected in sebaceous carcinoma. R3 lacks support and is contradicted by squamous cell proliferation.

rejected.why: Negative adipophilin and androgen receptor argue against sebaceous carcinoma despite PAS-positive clear cells.
Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells and lack of basaloid features contradict basal cell carcinoma.
